hook: Magic Trick beta adds a full-speed Atari Lynx FPGA core
hookText: Magic Trick beta adds a full-speed Atari Lynx FPGA core

beats.say: Built on CursedToast's ChroMagic, Magic Trick swaps FPGA cores automatically depending on the game you pick from the SD card, and adds cover art, previews, Game Genie and save states.
Beta 10 added the Lynx as a third core; beta 11 followed hours later with fixes, including sideways Lynx games.
Magic Trick 1.0.0-beta.10 puts the Atari Lynx on the ModRetro Chromatic: a full-speed FPGA core with save states and box art, and no BIOS needed.
